title: The Prophet and the Question of Succession — Part 371

sentences.en: She cried: "Today you have broken my heart.

On the Day of Judgment I will file a suit against you in the
Divine Court of Justice and Allah Almighty will decide the case justly.

Muhammad
is the master and lord; our and your promised time is the Day of Resurrection.
That day the transgressor will be losers, and your repentance will do you no good.

For everything there
is an appointed time and you will know before long who will be afflicted with scornful chastisement."

Caliph used abusive language
Hafiz: Who could dare to abuse part of the body of the Holy Prophet, Fatima Zahra?
Deception may be possible, but using abusive language is not possible.

Please do not say such
things.
Well-Wisher: No one had the courage to say such things except your Caliph, Abu Bakr.

Unable to rebut
the cogent reasoning of the oppressed lady, he immediately mounted the pulpit and insulted Fatima and
her husband and cousin, the loved one of Allah and of His Prophet, Amiru'l-Mu'minin ‘Ali.
Hafiz: I think these slanderous reports have been spread by fanatics.
These reports have not been spread by Shi’as fanatics.
